a: Yazaalibwa mu Clapham, London, nga 8 Apuli 1847, omwana w'omusuubuzi Frederick ne mukyala we Ann, era yakulira mu maka ag'emirembe era agatya Katonda. Okukyusibwa kwe tekwali kwa kwewuunyisa wadde okw'okuva mu bwavu; yakulira mu kitiibwa ky'abantu abagenda mu kkanisa, ng'atudde ng'akyali mwana wansi w'okubuulira kwa William Brock ku Bloomsbury Chapel. Yabatizibwa mu 1864, era ng'aweza emyaka kkumi na mukaaga yali amaze okumanya nti ayitiddwa mu buweereza; yatendekebwa mu Regent's Park College, era n'afuna diguli ye mu Yunivasite ya London mu 1869.

q: Omukwano gwe ne D. L. Moody gwamukola gutya?
a: Bwe yali omuweereza omuvubuka mu York, yasisinkana omubuulizi w'enjiri Omumerika Dwight L. Moody, eyali nga tamanyiddwa nnyo mu Bungereza, n'amuggulirawo enzigi mu makanisa g'e Bungereza, era bombi ne bafuuka mikwano gy'obulamu bwonna. Meyer yatwala amagezi ga Moody ng'okukwatibwako okusinga obukulu mu buweereza bwe — amagezi nti "omubuulizi omukulu ateekwa okuba omukozi omukulu, n'omukozi omukulu omubuulizi omukulu" — era okugatta okwo okw'obuweereza bw'ekituuti n'okukola okwennyini, ku luguudo, kwafuuka akabonero ak'omulimu gwe.

Mu Leicester yasisinkana omuzannyi wa kkulikeeti Charles T. Studd n'abaminsani abavubuka abaali bagenda mu China, essanyu lyabwe eritaliiko kire ne lyoleka ekintu kye yali abulwa. Bwe yagambibwa okwewaayo eri Kristo mu bwennyini, nga tasigazaawo kintu kyonna, Meyer yafukamira n'akwasa Kristo empeta eyalina ebisumuluzo byonna eby'obulamu bwe — okuggyako ekisumuluzo kimu ekitono eky'ekisenge kye eky'ekyama. Ng'atasobola kukiwaayo, yasaba nti: "Siri mwetegefu, naye ndi mwetegefu okufuulibwa omwetegefu"; era mu wiiki emu, bwe yategeeza, Kristo yali amaze okukimazeewo ddala n'akijjuza ekintu ekirungi ennyo okusinga.

q: Okwewaayo okw'okubiri kwe yayawula ku kukyusibwa kwe kwali kutya?
a: Mu kiseera lwe yawulira nga talina maanyi era nga takola kintu, yafuluma okunoonya Katonda yekka. Ng'atambula ku luguudo olw'obwerere ekiro kimu, yawulira okuyitibwa okufuna "okusiigwa okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ennyo" n'okukwetwalira mu kukkiriza kwokka, awatali kulinda kuwulira kwonna okugoberera. Yeewaayo eyo mu kye yayita "okukkiriza okwereere, okutaliiko kuwulira," era okuva ku ssaawa eyo obuweereza bwe ne bukyuka okuva ku kusomesa enjigiriza ne budda ku kukulembera abakkiriza mu kutambula kwabwe okwennyini ne Katonda mu maanyi g'Omwoyo.

Okuva ku Melbourne Hall mu Leicester (gye yatandikawo mu 1878, ekibiina kyayo ne kyambuka okutuuka mu nkumi) yasengukira mu London, ng'ayawula emyaka amakumi asatu wakati wa Regent's Park Chapel ne Christ Church, mu Lambeth. Yafuuka omu ku basomesa abaanoonyezebwa ennyo ku Lukuŋŋaana lwa Keswick, ng'ayogerera ku amakumi abiri mu mukaaga ku nkuŋŋaana zaayo, era yabuulira mu Bungereza yonna, mu Amerika, mu Kanada, Sudaafrika, Asia ne mu Buvanjuba obwa Wakati — emirundi kkumi n'ebiri gyonna mu Amerika, ogw'oluvannyuma nga gutandikiddwa ng'aweza emyaka kinaana.

q: Obutukuvu bwe bweyoleka butya mu kulongoosa embeera z'abantu?
a: Obutukuvu bwa Meyer tebwali bw'omunda bwokka. Yalwana olutalo olutakoowa ku bibi eby'omu kibuga kye — obutamiivu, omuzannyo gw'okusaba, n'obusuubuzi bw'obwenzi — era wakati mu myaka gy'ekyasa ekya 1890 ne 1907 kaweefube we atwalibwa nga ye yaggalawo ebikumi by'ennyumba z'obwenzi n'ennyumba z'omwenge. Yateeka mu buweereza bwe ekibiina ky'okuyamba abasibe, ennyumba z'abo abataliiko wabeera, ennyumba z'enfuuzi, n'omulimu gw'okusibako abaana. Abamulwanyisa baamusekereranga nga "Meyer Omutabuzi Omukaaba," naye gy'ali Katonda eyatwala omwoyo mu mirembe era yatwala omukono mu kitundu eky'obwavu.

Awamu n'ebibuulwa nga omutwalo mu nkumi mukaaga, yakola ebitabo ebisukka mu nsanvu, mwe muli ebyafaayo bya Bayibuli ebiwoomerevu ebya Ibulayimu, Musa, Eriya, Yokaana Omubatiza, Peetero ne Pawulo, n'ebitabo eby'okwewaayo ebimanyiddwa nga Okwebuuzaganya kwaffe kwa Buli Lunaku. Ebyafaayo bino tebyassa nnyo essira ku mbeera y'ebyafaayo wabula ku bulamu obw'omunda obw'omwoyo bw'abantu abatatuukiridde, mu abo ekisa kya Katonda mwe kibikkulirwa — endabirwamu, nga bwe yabitwala, Abakristaayo aba bulijjo mwe basobola okwetegeera olugendo lwabwe. Ebitabo bye byasala ensalo z'ebibiina era byatundibwa mu bukadde.

Mu Ekyama ky'Okuluŋŋamizibwa omutima gwe ogw'obusumba guwulikika bulambalamba: "Amaanyi gaffe n'emirembe gyaffe biva mu kumanya Katonda gy'ayagala tubeere n'okubeera eyo." Yawandiikira abo abeeraliikirira n'abalina emitima eminafu okusinga abo abeesiga, era amagezi ge ku kusaba tegaali ngeri ya kukola wabula omuwendo ogw'okwesiga — "Ebituufu bya Katonda, ebiteekeddwa ng'omusingi ogw'ejjinja ery'amaanyi. Okukkiriza kwaffe, okubikwata n'okubiwummulirako. Okuwulira okw'essanyu, okujja omulundi gumu oba oluvannyuma lw'ennaku n'emyezi, nga Katonda bw'ayagala."

Yali mwesimbu ku ntalo omuweereza azikuba awatali kulabibwa, era olwo lwe yatula mu lwatu ennyo lwali lwa buggya. Ng'aweereza mu kibuga kye kimu n'ababuulizi abaalina ebibiina ebinene okusinga ebibye, yakkiriza nti omutima gwe gwasobolanga okukwatibwa obuggya — era eddagala lye lyali lye limu lye yabuulira abalala: yatwala ekibi ku maviivi ge era n'asaba mu bugenderevu olw'okukulaakulana kwa banne, nti abantu beeyongere okugenda okubawulira, okutuusa obuggya lwe bwaggwaamu amaanyi n'okwagala ne kuzzibwawo.

Meyer yabuulira era yatambula kumpi okutuuka ku nkomerero. Mu Maaci 1929, ennaku ntonotono nga tannaweza emyaka kinaana mu ebiri, yamanya nti okufa kwe kwali kumpi, era ebbaluwa gye yaweereza mukwano gwe yasingira obulamu ebibuulwa bye bingi: "Nnyini kaakano nnawulira, mu kwewuunya kwange okunene, nti nsigadde n'ennaku ntonotono okubeera omulamu ... Teweeraliikirira kunwandiikira. Tunaasisinkana enkya." Yafa nga 28 Maaci 1929, n'akungubagirwa mu nsi yonna eyogera Olungereza ng'omusajja empapula z'amawulire gwe zaayita "Omulabirizi Omukulu ow'Amakanisa Ageetwala."
